_note: Static piece (docs/ART-REDO.md section 9, cliff face). The concept has no cliff, so the box is the theme.jpg rocks at the south road for their stone colours. A front face strip for the cliff cells (biomeLift 16): world height 16 (44 px). Tileable ends are not checked by the build (open question).
source_note: The reference shows no cliff: it is only the dark forest scene whose palette, evening light and voxel style the cliff must match; draw only one cliff and nothing else, no trees, no figures; use the reference rocks only for the colours of the stone
design: a steep wall of rough grey-brown stone in chunky blocky ledges and cracks, darker in the cracks, lighter on the lit top edge, a few tufts of dark grass on the ledges, the strip much wider than it is tall

variants.note: a face with a deep crack and a jutting ledge
